faq: Do I lose my content during a redesign?
No. We reuse your text, images, page names and settings and only change how they look. Before we begin, we save a restore point in your site history so the old version can always be brought back.
Can you switch me from Wix to Wix Studio?
Moving between the two is a rebuild, not a toggle. We can do it as part of a redesign when you want more layout control. Say so in the order form and we confirm what it adds.
We tidy and reorder your existing text so it fits the new layout. Full copywriting is a separate job, but we mark weak or missing sections in your handover note.
Does the redesign help with SEO?
It can. A faster, clearer site helps visitors and search engines. We keep titles and addresses where they are and add redirects for anything that moves. We cannot promise rankings.
desc:
A Wix website redesign for a modern look refreshes your current site's layout, fonts, colors and menu while keeping the content that already works. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your pages in the Wix editor and checks them on phone and desktop.

## What is a Wix website redesign?

A Wix website redesign changes how your existing site looks and is organized without starting over. We review what you have, propose a cleaner layout, set new fonts, colors and spacing, rebuild pages in the editor and tidy the menu. Your text, page names and search titles carry over, so you keep the value you have already built.

It differs from a design edit, which fixes individual items, and from a new build, which begins from nothing. A redesign changes the whole look while the substance stays.

## Why does an old site hurt a business?

Design ages. Cramped spacing, mismatched fonts, heavy banners and layouts built before phones dominated browsing make a business look behind the times. Visitors judge quickly, and a dated site may suggest the business itself is dated or inactive.

Old sites are also often slow. Large images, stacked sections and abandoned apps add weight. Menus grow with each new page until visitors cannot find anything. A redesign addresses the look and the usability together.

## How a redesign affects visitors and results

A cleaner layout makes content easier to scan. Clear headings, generous spacing and a short menu help people find the page they want. Properly sized images load more quickly, which matters most on mobile connections. Buttons and forms that are restyled consistently look trustworthy and are easier to use.

Keeping page names and search titles, and redirecting any address that changes, preserves what search engines already know about your site. A redesign alone cannot promise more enquiries, since results depend on traffic and offer, but it removes visual and technical barriers that were holding visitors back.

## What a good Wix redesign includes

- A short review of the current site and what should stay.
- New fonts, colors and spacing defined once and applied everywhere.
- A rebuilt header, menu and footer that are easy to navigate.
- Redesigned home page and key inner pages with clearer sections.
- Buttons and forms restyled to match the new look.
- Images resized and compressed for faster loading.
- Mobile layout treated as seriously as desktop.
- A simple style guide for your brand on larger packages.
- A preview link so you can approve before publishing.
- Old addresses kept or redirected, with text and titles carried over.

## What we do

We start by reviewing your pages, your analytics if you have them, and the features that must stay. We then propose the new direction, covering layout, fonts, colors and menu. After you agree, we rebuild the pages in your editor, resize images and check each page on both phone and desktop.

The Basic package refreshes the home page and one more page with a cleaner menu and footer. The Standard package redesigns up to six pages, creates a simple style guide and restyles headers, footers, forms and buttons. The Premium package covers a larger set with custom layouts and sections, scroll and hover animations, a speed and mobile pass, redirect checks and a period of fixes afterward. A logo refresh files add-on and a mobile polish pass can be added.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- List what you like and what you dislike about the current site.
- Tell us which pages bring the most visitors.
- Collect your best photos and any brand files.
- Review the preview link on a phone and a computer.
- Keep a copy of your current text.

**Avoid:**
- Changing the site structure and the look at the same time without a plan.
- Replacing every photo with stock images.
- Adding heavy animation on every section.
- Renaming pages without redirects.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A business whose site was built years ago and no longer matches its brand.
- An owner who has outgrown a template and wants the pages to feel more custom.
- A company with a rebrand that needs the website to follow.
- A site owner whose pages are slow and cluttered, and who wants a calmer, faster layout.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, examples of designs you admire, and any brand files such as logos, fonts and colors. Tell us about pages or features that must not change. Add us as a collaborator or team member in your Wix account, so we never need your password. We keep a restore point in your site history and publish only after you approve the preview.
